observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black electronic keyboard with 61 keys, wrapped in clear plastic film.
The keyboard has a central control panel with a small screen, buttons, and a green circular logo with a stylized 'M' or 'P' inside.
The keys are white and black, standard piano-style layout.
The keyboard is placed on a surface with other electronic instruments visible in the background, including a guitar and another keyboard.
The plastic wrap is intact, suggesting the item is new or unused.
No visible damage to the keys or casing in the photos.
The seller's text mentions 'high-quality sound, responsive playability, and versatile' — these are subjective claims, not verifiable from photos.

claims.claim: high-quality sound, responsive playability, and versatile
claims.evidence: These are subjective performance claims; no audio or playability test is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be non-functional or have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the keyboard powered on, keys responding, and sound output.

risks.risk: The plastic wrap may be old or the item may have been previously used, despite appearance.
risks.proof: Close-up of the plastic wrap edges and any signs of wear, or a photo of the keyboard without wrap.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used, with potential for hidden wear

risks.risk: The keyboard may be a counterfeit or non-genuine product.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand name and model number on the keyboard, ideally with a serial number or barcode.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on and playing notes to verify functionality.
Close-up photo of the brand and model name on the keyboard.
Photo of the keyboard without plastic wrap to check for wear or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
